scope: Disposable local Git, SQLite, authenticated loopback HTTPS and maintained native Lattice; no deployment, publication, lifecycle acceptance or release authority
consumer: Kiln single-tenant review workspace and canonical CI engine
durable_capability: Repeatable source-bound review intake, owner approval, suggestion publication and candidate-CI integration queue with durable effect reconciliation

required_ci.policy: require_ci=true throughout the successful and failing native review paths
required_ci.result: Success, exact run source matched constructed candidate and independently observed target
required_ci.failure: A genuinely failing source assertion produced DomainFailure and blocked submission without changing that target

restart.native: Forced service exit after durable candidate construction; exact same queue entry and candidate recovered before actual canonical CI dispatch
restart.deterministic_queue_regression: Restarting both Workspace and Engine with an existing candidate/run retained those identities and one dispatch; moved targets required distinct candidates and runs
restart.limit: Killing HTTPS during active worker ingress can fail cache or log upload. Failure blocks submission; uninterrupted in-flight transport and automatic retries are not claimed.
restart.fixture_correction: native-03 records a typed-builder export mismatch, corrected by reusing service-inputs.json rather than re-importing the runtime export
restart.browser_correction: native-04/verification.json retains initial delivery-object formatting and prose-suggestion selector findings; both corrected before native-05 browser qualification

boundaries: Source approvals remain bound to the immutable reviewed revision; exact candidate CI is separate
No browser assertion can satisfy CI or merge authority
Provider effects reserve durable identities before execution and reconcile uncertain outcomes
Only admitted HTTPS destinations and recipients receive notification metadata; private drafts and comment bodies are excluded
Email delivery is an explicitly configured HTTPS email-adapter envelope, not a built-in SMTP service
External repository writers require OS or forge enforcement outside Kiln
Final native and browser fixtures exited all owned processes and removed credentials and scratch state
